correctness.rationale: The exact square-coordinate equation yields precisely two nonzero-sign branches, or one degenerate zero line. The remaining coordinates are forced and the only remaining scalar condition is linear in the source z. Its two zero coefficients vanish together iff X=2a,W=0, proving the exact hole. The determinant abc*y^2*(2-w^2) is verified algebraically and its critical images all have Y=0. On X=2a,W=delta both inverse z coordinates have the exact same pole -Y/(2*b*delta); a standalone symbolic checker confirms determinants, inverse identities, representative fibers and limits.

value.rationale: Inverse fibers are a natural, structurally important invariant for noninvertible four-dimensional maps used for nonlinear recurrence. This is a complete all-target classification for every positive source parameter, not one chosen numerical slice. The interior omitted output stratum, though in the closure of the global image, is not a finite critical-value caustic; both missing inverse sheets escape to infinity with the same exact coefficient. This distinguishes finite folding from nonproper backward state loss and informs whether backward trajectories, preimage transfer operators and state reconstruction can be defined. No unsupported claim on forward chaos is required.
